chapter: Philadelphia and the McRae Brothers Band, 1908-1929
title: Neighborhood at 22nd and Diamond; father's death
summary: The family lived in an exclusive North Philadelphia neighborhood; his father died when he was about fifteen and his mother raised the children.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You lived in North Philadelphia near 22nd and Susquehanna (inaudible) Avenue?

Yes, 22nd and Diamond. We lived at 22nd and Diamond. We were the very -- very exclusive That was a (inaudible) neighborhood by my father being a real estate man. He bought in that neighborhood. And then he died earlier in my life. I think I was about 15 years old when he passed away.

And my mother raised us. She took over the problems. Then we moved back to South Philly.

And we went to school in Philly -- all my brothers. I think my sister, Bob and I, we studied mostly in Philly. But my two oldest brothers before they came they were in college, in Morehouse (inaudible), and things like that.
